contract: Wrap actual Compose content and toggle trigger; initial composition/context reset does not capture. Default WINDOW_PIXELS uses PixelCopy on the hosting Activity or Compose Dialog window,after a frame,with1500ms timeout. Clamps to measured visible window bounds and16million pixels. FLAG_SECURE always rejects capture,including explicit SOFTWARE_VIEW mode. Source/context changes cancel pending requests; late PixelCopy buffers are recycled. Host owns returned bitmap; no file,media permission or upload. SOFTWARE_VIEW is explicit fallback/test strategy using decorView.draw andreports its method; not evidence of hardware/window capture. Source sample normal/navigation/tab layouts adapted; native bars/globe glyph differ. Dialog/window coordinate cases,SurfaceView/GL content,offscreen content and physical PixelCopy/iOS parity remain unverified. Host tests verify cropped software pixels,secure rejection and context reset only.
